name: Northwind Cloud
about: Project management SaaS for small agencies: boards, time tracking and client reports.

topics.bugs_performance: The customer talks about errors, crashes, slowness, outages or data that is wrong or missing.
topics.onboarding_docs: The customer talks about setting up the product, learning it, the documentation or migrating data in.
topics.pricing_billing: The customer talks about plans, price changes, invoices, charges, cancellation or refunds.
topics.support: The customer talks about contact with the support or success team, replies and waiting times.
topics.features: The customer talks about what the product can or cannot do, missing features or requests.
topics.security_privacy: The customer talks about data protection, permissions, GDPR, compliance or access control.
topics.other: Anything else, or a review that gives no specific reason.

facts: Customers can export all their data from Settings, Export, at any time.
Plan changes take effect at the next billing date and annual plans can be cancelled with a prorated credit only within 14 days of renewal.
The status page is at status.northwind-cloud.example.
Customers can reach customer success by email at help@northwind-cloud.example.
never: promise a refund, credit, discount or any compensation in a public reply
ask for account details, email addresses or passwords in a public reply
blame the customer or argue about what happened
make claims about security or compliance that are not in the list of facts
state a fact, deadline or policy that is not in the list of facts
